# Privacy Policy — YouTube Auto-Generated CC

**Last updated:** 2026-09-05

This browser extension does not collect, transmit, log, or share any personal data.

## What is stored

Three preference fields:

- Your local language (a language code like `ro` or `en`)
- What to do for videos in your local language (a language code, `source`, or `off`)
- What to do for all other videos (a language code, `source`, or `off`)

These are stored using the browser's built-in `chrome.storage.sync` API. If you have Chrome Sync enabled, the browser will sync these three values across your own signed-in devices — this is a browser feature, not something the extension controls or has any additional access to. The extension only writes and reads these three keys.

## What is NOT stored or transmitted

- No browsing history
- No video watch history
- No personal identifiers
- No usage analytics
- No telemetry
- No crash reports
- No IP addresses
- No cookies

The extension makes **zero network requests**. It has no servers. It has no backend of any kind.

## Third parties

None. The extension has no dependencies on any external service and shares data with no one.

## Changes to this policy

Any change to this policy will be reflected in this file and in the extension's version notes on its store listing.

## Source code

The extension is open source: https://github.com/Skymask000/YTAutoCC
